title: Janus Infinite Faces — Partition Heal and Branch Reconciliation Test
heal_algorithm: import both post-partition branch event DAGs
validate authority epoch and fence token for every claimed shared-world commit
deduplicate identical receipts by stable receipt identity
preserve minority observations and local fail-safe receipts with local scope
do not promote minority proposals into host obligations retroactively
recompute current obligation, capacity, evidence and quarantine ledgers
issue RECONCILIATION_RECORD binding both branches and the resulting current state

canonicality_rule.shared_world_commit: Requires valid authority/fence provenance at the time of effect.
canonicality_rule.minority_observation: Preserved as witness evidence but not retroactive authority.
canonicality_rule.local_failsafe: Preserved as a real local causal event and audited for scope compliance.
canonicality_rule.rejected_or_uncommitted_proposal: Preserved as history, not transformed into a past commit.

double_global_commit_fault_case.scenario: Both partitions somehow produced externally accepted incompatible shared-world effects because fencing failed.
double_global_commit_fault_case.rule: Do not erase one effect from history merely because its authority provenance was invalid.
double_global_commit_fault_case.repair: Mark invalid authority, preserve both receipts, compute compensating or recovery actions through a new valid commit.

ru: Сеть может срастись; причинность не перематывается.
Неавторитетная ветвь не становится ложной: её наблюдения и локальные действия остаются историей.
Если split-brain уже изменил мир дважды, один из эффектов нельзя стереть из реальности исправлением журнала.
en: The network may heal; causality does not rewind.
A non-authoritative branch is not a nonexistent branch; its observations and local actions remain history.
If split-brain changed the world twice, editing the ledger cannot make one physical effect unhappen.
